module APIV2
    module Public
      class Markets < Grape::API
        helpers ::APIV2::OrderHelpers
        helpers ::APIV2::ParamHelpers

        class OrderBook < Struct.new(:asks, :bids, :timestamp); end

        resource :markets do
          desc 'Get all available markets.',
            is_array: true,
            success: APIV2::Entities::Market
          params do
            use :pagination
            optional :ordering,
                     values: { value: %w(asc desc), message: 'public.markets.invalid_ordering' },
                     default: 'asc',
                     desc: 'If set, returned values will be sorted in specific order, defaults to \'asc\'.'
            optional :order_by,
                     values: { value: %w(id position), message: 'public.markets.invalid_order_by' },
                     default: 'position',
                     desc: 'Name of the field, which result will be ordered by.'
            optional :base_unit,
                     type: String,
                     values: { value: -> (v){ ::Currency.exists?(v) },
                               message: 'public.markets.base_unit_doesnt_exist' },
                     desc: 'Strict filter for base unit'
            optional :quote_unit,
                     type: String,
                     values: { value: -> (v){ ::Currency.exists?(v) },
                               message: 'public.markets.quote_unit_doesnt_exist' },
                     desc: 'Strict filter for quote unit'
            optional :search, type: JSON, default: {} do
              optional :base_code,
                       type: String,
                       desc: 'Search base currency code using LIKE'
              optional :quote_code,
                       type: String,
                       desc: 'Search qoute currency code using LIKE'
              optional :base_name,
                       type: String,
                       desc: 'Search base currency name using LIKE'
              optional :quote_name,
                       type: String,
                       desc: 'Search quote currency name using LIKE'
            end
          end
          get "/" do
            search_params = params[:search]
                              .slice(:base_code, :quote_code, :base_name, :quote_name)
                              .transform_keys {|k| "#{k}_cont"}
                              .merge(m: 'or')

            search = ::Market.active
                             .where(params.slice(:base_unit, :quote_unit))
                             .ransack(search_params)

            # Add default ordering (position asc) for cases markets where unit position is same.
            search.sorts = ["#{params[:order_by]} #{params[:ordering]}", "position asc"]

            present paginate(Rails.cache.fetch("markets_#{params}", expires_in: 600) { search.result.load.to_a }),
                    with: APIV2::Entities::Market,
                    extended: !!params[:extended]
          end

          desc 'Get the order book of specified market.',
            is_array: true,
            success: APIV2::Entities::OrderBook
          params do
            requires :market,
                     type: String,
                     values: { value: -> { ::Market.active.ids }, message: 'public.market.doesnt_exist' },
                     desc: -> { APIV2::Entities::Market.documentation[:id] }
            optional :asks_limit,
                     type: { value: Integer, message: 'public.order_book.non_integer_ask_limit' },
                     values: { value: 1..200, message: 'public.order_book.invalid_ask_limit' },
                     default: 20,
                     desc: 'Limit the number of returned sell orders. Default to 20.'
            optional :bids_limit,
                     type: { value: Integer, message: 'public.order_book.non_integer_bid_limit' },
                     values: { value: 1..200, message: 'public.order_book.invalid_bid_limit' },
                     default: 20,
                     desc: 'Limit the number of returned buy orders. Default to 20.'
          end
          get ":market/order-book", requirements: { market: /[\w\.\-]+/ } do
            asks = OrderAsk.active.with_market(params[:market]).matching_rule.limit(params[:asks_limit])
            bids = OrderBid.active.with_market(params[:market]).matching_rule.limit(params[:bids_limit])
            book = OrderBook.new asks, bids, Time.now.to_i
            present book, with: APIV2::Entities::OrderBook
          end

          desc 'Get recent trades on market, each trade is included only once. Trades are sorted in reverse creation order.',
            is_array: true,
            success: APIV2::Entities::Trade
          params do
            requires :market,
                     type: String,
                     values: { value: -> { ::Market.active.ids }, message: 'public.market.doesnt_exist' },
                     desc: -> { APIV2::Entities::Market.documentation[:id] }
            optional :limit,
                     type: { value: Integer, message: 'public.trade.non_integer_limit' },
                     values: { value: 1..1000, message: 'public.trade.invalid_limit' },
                     default: 100,
                     desc: 'Limit the number of returned trades. Default to 100.'
            optional :timestamp,
                     type: { value: Integer, message: 'public.trade.non_integer_timestamp' },
                     desc: "An integer represents the seconds elapsed since Unix epoch."\
                       "If set, only trades executed before the time will be returned."
            optional :order_by,
                     type: String,
                     values: { value: %w(asc desc), message: 'public.trade.invalid_order_by' },
                     default: 'desc',
                     desc: "If set, returned trades will be sorted in specific order, default to 'desc'."
          end
          get ":market/trades", requirements: { market: /[\w\.\-]+/ } do
            present Trade.public_from_influx(params[:market], params[:limit]), with: APIV2::Entities::PublicTrade
          end

          desc 'Get depth or specified market. Both asks and bids are sorted from highest price to lowest.'
          params do
            requires :market,
                     type: String,
                     values: { value: -> { ::Market.active.ids }, message: 'public.market.doesnt_exist' },
                     desc: -> { APIV2::Entities::Market.documentation[:id] }
            optional :limit,
                     type: { value: Integer, message: 'public.market_depth.non_integer_limit' },
                     values: { value: 1..1000, message: 'public.market_depth.invalid_limit' },
                     default: 300,
                     desc: 'Limit the number of returned price levels. Default to 300.'
          end
          get ":market/depth", requirements: { market: /[\w\.\-]+/ } do
            # Use Redis cache for order book
            OrderBookCache.get(params[:market], params[:limit])
          end

          desc 'Get OHLC(k line) of specific market.'
          params do
            requires :market,
                     type: String,
                     values: { value: -> { ::Market.active.ids }, message: 'public.market.doesnt_exist' },
                     desc: -> { APIV2::Entities::Market.documentation[:id] }
            optional :period,
                     type: { value: Integer, message: 'public.k_line.non_integer_period' },
                     values: { value: KLineService::AVAILABLE_POINT_PERIODS, message: 'public.k_line.invalid_period' },
                     default: 1,
                     desc: "Time period of K line, default to 1. You can choose between #{KLineService::AVAILABLE_POINT_PERIODS.join(', ')}"
            optional :time_from,
                     type: { value: Integer, message: 'public.k_line.non_integer_time_from' },
                     allow_blank: { value: false, c_name: 'k_line' },
                     desc: "An integer represents the seconds elapsed since Unix epoch. If set, only k-line data after that time will be returned."
            optional :time_to,
                     type: { value: Integer, message: 'public.k_line.non_integer_time_to' },
                     allow_blank: { value: false, c_name: 'k_line' },
                     desc: "An integer represents the seconds elapsed since Unix epoch. If set, only k-line data till that time will be returned."
            optional :limit,
                     type: { value: Integer, message: 'public.k_line.non_integer_limit' },
                     values: { value: KLineService::AVAILABLE_POINT_LIMITS, message: 'public.k_line.invalid_limit' },
                     default: 30,
                     desc: "Limit the number of returned data points default to 30. Ignored if time_from and time_to are given."
          end
          get ":market/k-line", requirements: { market: /[\w\.\-]+/ } do
            k_line_data = KLineService[params[:market], params[:period]]
              .get_ohlc(params.slice(:limit, :time_from, :time_to))
            
            # Return in expected format for frontend
            { k_line: k_line_data }
          end

          desc 'Get ticker of all markets (For response doc see /:market/tickers/ response).'
          get "/tickers" do
            Rails.cache.fetch(:markets_tickers, expires_in: 10) do
              begin
                ::Market.active.ordered.inject({}) do |h, m|
                  begin
                    ticker_data = TickersService[m].ticker
                    h[m.id] = format_ticker(ticker_data) if ticker_data.present?
                  rescue => e
                    Rails.logger.warn "Failed to get ticker for market #{m.id}: #{e.message}"
                    # Use default ticker data for failed markets
                    h[m.id] = format_ticker({
                      at: Time.now.to_i,
                      avg_price: '0.0',
                      high: '0.0',
                      last: '0.0',
                      low: '0.0',
                      open: '0.0',
                      price_change_percent: '+0.00%',
                      volume: '0.0',
                      amount: '0.0'
                    })
                  end
                  h
                end
              rescue => e
                Rails.logger.error "Failed to fetch all tickers: #{e.message}"
                {}
              end
            end
          end

          desc 'Get ticker of specific market.',
               success: APIV2::Entities::Ticker
          params do
            requires :market,
                     type: String,
                     values: { value: -> { ::Market.active.ids }, message: 'public.market.doesnt_exist' },
                     desc: -> { APIV2::Entities::Market.documentation[:id] }
          end
          get "/:market/tickers/", requirements: { market: /[\w\.\-]+/ } do
            present format_ticker(TickersService[params[:market]].ticker),
                    with: APIV2::Entities::Ticker
          end
        end
      end
    end

# encoding: UTF-8
# frozen_string_literal: true
module Orbitex
 module InfluxDB
  class << self
    def client(opts={})
      # Map InfluxDB clients with received opts.
      clients[opts] ||= create_client(parse(config.merge(opts)))
    end

    def config
      yaml = ::Pathname.new("config/influxtest.yml")
      return {} unless yaml.exist?

      erb = ::ERB.new(yaml.read)
      ::YAML.safe_load(erb.result, aliases: true)[ENV.fetch('RAILS_ENV', 'development')].symbolize_keys || {}
    end

    def clients
      @clients ||= {}
    end

    def parse(configs)
      # Handle both InfluxDB v1 and v2 configurations
      if configs[:token].present? && configs[:org].present?
        # InfluxDB v2 configuration
        {
          url: configs[:url],
          token: configs[:token],
          org: configs[:org],
          bucket: configs[:bucket],
          keyshard: configs[:keyshard]
        }
      else
        # InfluxDB v1 configuration (legacy)
        hosts = configs[:host]
        configs[:host] = hosts[Zlib::crc32(configs[:keyshard].to_s) % hosts.count] if hosts.is_a?(Array)
        configs
      end
    end

    def create_client(configs)
      if configs[:token].present? && configs[:org].present?
        # InfluxDB v2 client
        require 'influxdb-client'
        InfluxDB2::Client.new(
          configs[:url],
          configs[:token],
          org: configs[:org],
          bucket: configs[:bucket],
          use_ssl: false
        )
      else
        # InfluxDB v1 client (legacy)
        ::InfluxDB::Client.new(configs)
      end
    end

    def write_point(table_name, data, precision = 'ns', retention_policy = nil, database = nil, async = false)
      client_config = parse(config)
      if client_config[:token].present? && client_config[:org].present?
        # InfluxDB v2 write
        influx_client = create_client(client_config)
        write_api = influx_client.create_write_api
        point = InfluxDB2::Point.new(name: table_name)
        
        data.each do |key, value|
          if key == :time
            point.time(value, InfluxDB2::WritePrecision::NANOSECOND)
          elsif key == :tags
            value.each { |tag_key, tag_value| point.add_tag(tag_key.to_s, tag_value.to_s) }
          else
            point.add_field(key.to_s, value)
          end
        end
        
        write_api.write(data: point, bucket: client_config[:bucket], org: client_config[:org], precision: InfluxDB2::WritePrecision::NANOSECOND)
      else
        # InfluxDB v1 write (legacy)
        client = create_client(client_config)
        client.write_point(table_name, data, precision, retention_policy, database, async)
      end
    end

    def query(query, opts = {})
      client_config = parse(config)
      if client_config[:token].present? && client_config[:org].present?
        # InfluxDB v2 query
        influx_client = create_client(client_config)
        query_api = influx_client.create_query_api
        result = query_api.query(query: query)
        result
      else
        # InfluxDB v1 query (legacy)
        client = create_client(client_config)
        client.query(query, opts)
      end
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'orbitex/influxdb'
require 'timeout'

class TickersService
  ZERO = '0.0'.to_d
  CACHE_DURATION = 5.seconds # Cache for 5 seconds for high-frequency updates

  class << self
    def [](market)
      services[market] ||= new(market)
    end

    def services
      @services ||= {}
    end

    def all_tickers
      Rails.cache.fetch('all_tickers', expires_in: CACHE_DURATION) do
        Market.enabled.includes(:base_currency, :quote_currency).map do |market|
          service = new(market)
          {
            market: market.id,
            ticker: service.ticker
          }
        end
      end
    end
  end

  attr_accessor :market_id

  def initialize(market)
    if market.is_a? Market
      @market_id = market.id
    else
      @market_id = market.to_s
    end
  end

  def ticker
    Rails.cache.fetch("ticker_#{market_id}", expires_in: CACHE_DURATION) do
      # Try InfluxDB first with timeout protection
      influx_ticker = get_ticker_from_influx_with_timeout
      if influx_ticker.present? && influx_ticker[:last].to_f > 0
        return format(influx_ticker)
      end

      # Fallback: Get from database as secondary source
      db_ticker = get_ticker_from_database
      if db_ticker.present? && db_ticker[:last].to_f > 0
        return format(db_ticker)
      end

      # Final fallback: Default ticker with realistic prices
      default_ticker_with_last_price
    end
  end

  private

  def get_ticker_from_influx_with_timeout
    begin
      # Use timeout to prevent hanging - 3 seconds for InfluxDB 2
      Timeout::timeout(3) do
        get_ticker_from_influx_v2
      end
    rescue Timeout::Error
      Rails.logger.warn "InfluxDB timeout for market #{market_id}"
      nil
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.warn "Failed to get ticker from InfluxDB for #{market_id}: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def get_ticker_from_influx_v2
    begin
      client_config = Orbitex::Influxdb.config
      return nil if client_config.blank? || client_config[:token].blank?

      influx_client = Orbitex::Influxdb.create_client(client_config)
      query_api = influx_client.create_query_api

      # Simplified query for better performance
      query = build_influx_query_v2(client_config[:bucket])
      
      result = query_api.query(query: query)
      process_influx_result_v2(result)
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.warn "InfluxDB v2 query failed for #{market_id}: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def build_influx_query_v2(bucket)
    %{
      from(bucket: "#{bucket}")
        |> range(start: -24h)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "trades")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r.market == "#{market_id}")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "price" or r._field == "amount")
        |> group(columns: ["_field"])
        |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    }
  end

  def process_influx_result_v2(result)
    ticker_data = default_ticker
    prices = []
    amounts = []
    
    result.each do |table|
      table.records.each do |record|
        case record.field
        when 'price'
          prices << record.value.to_f
        when 'amount'
          amounts << record.value.to_f
        end
      end
    end

    if prices.any?
      ticker_data[:min] = prices.min
      ticker_data[:max] = prices.max
      ticker_data[:first] = prices.first
      ticker_data[:last] = prices.last
      ticker_data[:vwap] = prices.sum / prices.size
    end

    if amounts.any?
      ticker_data[:volume] = amounts.sum
      ticker_data[:amount] = amounts.sum
    end

    ticker_data
  rescue => e
    Rails.logger.warn "Failed to process InfluxDB result for #{market_id}: #{e.message}"
    nil
  end

  def get_ticker_from_database
    begin
      # Get 24h stats from database (faster fallback)
      trades_24h = Trade.where(market_id: market_id)
                        .where('created_at > ?', 24.hours.ago)
                        .select(:price, :amount, :created_at)
                        .order(:created_at)

      return nil if trades_24h.empty?

      prices = trades_24h.pluck(:price)
      amounts = trades_24h.pluck(:amount)
      
      {
        min: prices.min,
        max: prices.max,
        last: prices.last,
        first: prices.first,
        volume: amounts.sum,
        amount: amounts.sum,
        vwap: calculate_vwap(trades_24h)
      }
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.warn "Failed to get ticker from database for #{market_id}: #{e.message}"
      nil
    end
  end

  def calculate_vwap(trades)
    return ZERO if trades.empty?
    
    total_amount = trades.sum(:amount)
    return ZERO if total_amount.zero?
    
    weighted_sum = trades.sum { |trade| trade.price * trade.amount }
    weighted_sum / total_amount
  end

  def default_ticker
    { min: ZERO, max: ZERO, last: ZERO, first: ZERO, volume: ZERO, amount: ZERO, vwap: ZERO }
  end

  def default_ticker_with_last_price
    ticker = default_ticker
    
    # Try to get the last trade price from database
    begin
      last_trade = Trade.where(market_id: market_id)
                        .order(created_at: :desc)
                        .first
      
      if last_trade.present?
        price = last_trade.price.to_f
        ticker[:last] = price
        ticker[:first] = price
        ticker[:min] = price
        ticker[:max] = price
        ticker[:vwap] = price
      else
        # Set default prices for demo markets
        default_prices = {
          'btcusdt' => 43250.50,
          'ethusdt' => 2650.75,
          'nearusdt' => 2.15,
          'adausdt' => 0.45,
          'solusdt' => 95.30
        }
        
        default_price = default_prices[market_id.downcase] || 1.0
        ticker[:last] = default_price
        ticker[:first] = default_price
        ticker[:min] = default_price * 0.95
        ticker[:max] = default_price * 1.05
        ticker[:vwap] = default_price
        ticker[:volume] = rand(1000..10000)
        ticker[:amount] = ticker[:volume] * default_price
      end
    rescue => e
      Rails.logger.warn "Failed to get last trade for #{market_id}: #{e.message}"
    end
    
    format(ticker)
  end

  def format(ticker)
    # Ensure ticker has all required fields with defaults
    ticker = default_ticker.merge(ticker || {})
    
    # Convert all values to proper decimal format
    ticker.each do |key, value|
      ticker[key] = value.to_d if value.respond_to?(:to_d)
    end

    {
      at: Time.now.to_i,
      avg_price: ticker[:vwap].to_d,
      high: ticker[:max].to_d,
      last: ticker[:last].to_d,
      low: ticker[:min].to_d,
      open: ticker[:first].to_d,
      price_change_percent: change_ratio(ticker[:first].to_d, ticker[:last].to_d),
      volume: ticker[:volume].to_d,
      amount: ticker[:amount].to_d
    }.transform_values(&:to_s)
  end

  def change_ratio(open, last)
    percent = open.zero? ? 0 : (last - open) / open * 100

    # Prepend sign. Show two digits after the decimal point. Append '%'.
    "#{'%+.2f' % percent}%"
  end
end

    39	  # OHCL - open, high, closing, and low prices.
    40	  def get_ohlc(options = {})
    41	    options = options.symbolize_keys.tap do |o|
    42	      o.delete(:limit) if o[:time_from].present? && o[:time_to].present?
    43	    end
    44	
    45	    time_from = options[:time_from]
    46	    time_to = options[:time_to]
    47	    limit = options[:limit] || 200
    48	
    49	    # Try to fetch from InfluxDB with caching
    50	    cache_key = "kline:#{@market_id}:#{@period}:#{limit}:#{time_from}:#{time_to}"
    51	    Rails.cache.fetch(cache_key, expires_in: 1.minute) do
    52	      fetch_ohlc_from_influx(time_from, time_to, limit)
    53	    end
    54	  end
    55	  
    56	  private
    57	  
    58	  def fetch_ohlc_from_influx(time_from, time_to, limit)
    59	    # Build Flux query that pivots fields into columns for easier processing
    60	    flux_query = %{
    61	      import "influxdata/influxdb/v1"
    62	      
    63	      from(bucket: "#{Orbitex::InfluxDB.config[:bucket]}")
    64	        |> range(start: #{time_from ? time_from.to_i : '-30d'}, stop: #{time_to ? time_to.to_i : 'now()'})
    65	        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "candles_#{@period}")
    66	        |> filter(fn: (r) => r.market == "#{@market_id}")
    67	        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "open" or r._field == "high" or r._field == "low" or r._field == "close" or r._field == "volume")
    68	        |> v1.fieldsAsCols()
    69	        |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    70	        |> limit(n: #{limit})
    71	    }
    72	
    73	    begin
    74	      # Create client directly
    75	      client_config = Orbitex::InfluxDB.config
    76	      influx_client = Orbitex::InfluxDB.create_client(client_config)
    77	      query_api = influx_client.create_query_api
    78	      
    79	      result = query_api.query(query: flux_query)
    80	      
    81	      # Process the result and return OHLC data
    82	      ohlc_data = []
    83	      candle_map = {}
    84	      
    85	      if result && result.any?
    86	        result.each do |table|
    87	          records = table.respond_to?(:records) ? table.records : table
    88	          records = [records] unless records.is_a?(Array)
    89	          
    90	          records.each do |record|
    91	            next unless record.respond_to?(:values)
    92	            
    93	            time = record.values["_time"]&.to_i
    94	            next unless time
    95	            
    96	            # Extract OHLCV values
    97	            open = record.values["open"]&.to_f || 0.0
    98	            high = record.values["high"]&.to_f || 0.0
    99	            low = record.values["low"]&.to_f || 0.0
   100	            close = record.values["close"]&.to_f || 0.0
   101	            volume = record.values["volume"]&.to_f || 0.0
   102	            
   103	            # Store in map by timestamp
   104	            candle_map[time] = [time, open, high, low, close, volume]
   105	          end
   106	        end
   107	      end
   108	      
   109	      # Convert map to sorted array
   110	      ohlc_data = candle_map.values.sort_by { |candle| candle[0] }
   111	      
   112	      # Fallback to PostgreSQL if no data from InfluxDB
   113	      if ohlc_data.empty?
   114	        Rails.logger.warn "No candle data from InfluxDB for #{@market_id} #{@period}, falling back to PostgreSQL"
   115	        ohlc_data = fallback_to_postgresql(time_from, time_to, limit)
   116	      end
   117	      
   118	      return ohlc_data
   119	    rescue => e
   120	      Rails.logger.error "Error fetching OHLC data from InfluxDB: #{e.message}"
   121	      Rails.logger.error e.backtrace.join("\n")
   122	      
   123	      # Fallback to PostgreSQL
   124	      return fallback_to_postgresql(time_from, time_to, limit)
   125	    end
   126	  end
   127	  
   128	  def fallback_to_postgresql(time_from, time_to, limit)
   129	    Rails.logger.info "Generating candles from PostgreSQL trades for #{@market_id}"
   130	
   131	    period_minutes = @period.to_i
   132	    period_seconds = period_minutes * POINT_PERIOD_IN_SECONDS
   133	
   134	    scope = Trade.where(market_id: @market_id).order(:created_at)
   135	    scope = scope.where('created_at >= ?', Time.at(time_from.to_i)) if time_from.present?
   136	    scope = scope.where('created_at <= ?', Time.at(time_to.to_i)) if time_to.present?
   137	
   138	    grouped = {}
   139	
   140	    scope.find_each do |trade|
   141	      bucket_start = (trade.created_at.to_i / period_seconds) * period_seconds
   142	      candle = grouped[bucket_start] ||= {
   143	        time: bucket_start,
   144	        open: trade.price.to_f,
   145	        high: trade.price.to_f,
   146	        low: trade.price.to_f,
   147	        close: trade.price.to_f,
   148	        volume: 0.0
   149	      }
   150	
   151	      price = trade.price.to_f
   152	      amount = trade.amount.to_f
   153	
   154	      candle[:high] = [candle[:high], price].max
   155	      candle[:low] = [candle[:low], price].min
   156	      candle[:close] = price
   157	      candle[:volume] += amount
   158	    end
   159	
   160	    grouped
   161	      .values
   162	      .sort_by { |candle| candle[:time] }
   163	      .last(limit.to_i)
   164	      .map do |candle|
   165	        [
   166	          candle[:time],
   167	          candle[:open],
   168	          candle[:high],
   169	          candle[:low],
   170	          candle[:close],
   171	          candle[:volume].round(8)
   172	        ]
   173	      end
   174	  end

   180	    flux_query = %{

I found a concrete production bug in Trade.public_from_influx: the rescue block has a stray default token at [trade.rb:133](/Users/cryptodelic/Documents/2025Projects/Orbitex/Development/OrbitexExchange/orbitex-clean/app/models/trade.rb:133). That means if Influx access fails, the fallback path can raise again instead of returning PostgreSQL trades, which cleanly explains the live 500 on /trades. I’m patching that and hardening the Influx client setup so Cloud Influx URLs behave correctly in production.

#!/bin/bash

# Google Cloud Run Deployment Script for Orbitex Rails Backend
# This script deploys using the Cloud Run configuration file

set -e  # Exit on any error

# Configuration
PROJECT_ID="nice-azimuth-310713"
REGION="us-central1"
SERVICE_NAME="orbitex"
IMAGE_NAME="gcr.io/$PROJECT_ID/$SERVICE_NAME"
VERSION=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

echo -e "${BLUE}🚀 Starting Google Cloud Run Deployment for Orbitex Rails${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}================================================================${NC}"

# Validate required files
echo -e "${YELLOW}📋 Validating project files...${NC}"
if [ ! -f "Gemfile" ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}❌ Gemfile not found!${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "config/application.rb" ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}❌ Rails application.rb not found!${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f "cloud-run-config.yaml" ]; then
    echo -e "${RED}❌ Cloud Run configuration file not found!${NC}"
    exit 1
fi

echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Project validation passed${NC}"

# Set up Google Cloud project
echo -e "${YELLOW}🔧 Setting up Google Cloud project...${NC}"
gcloud config set project $PROJECT_ID
gcloud config set run/region $REGION

# Build and push Docker image
echo -e "${YELLOW}🔨 Building and pushing Docker image...${NC}"
gcloud builds submit --tag $IMAGE_NAME:$VERSION --machine-type='E2_HIGHCPU_8' --project $PROJECT_ID

# Tag as latest
echo -e "${YELLOW}🏷️  Tagging as latest...${NC}"
gcloud container images add-tag $IMAGE_NAME:$VERSION $IMAGE_NAME:latest --quiet

# Update the Cloud Run configuration with the new image
echo -e "${YELLOW}📝 Updating Cloud Run configuration...${NC}"
sed -i.bak "s|image: .*|image: $IMAGE_NAME:$VERSION|" cloud-run-config.yaml

# Deploy using the configuration file
echo -e "${YELLOW}🚀 Deploying to Google Cloud Run...${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}📊 Deployment Configuration:${NC}"
echo "  Service Name: $SERVICE_NAME"
echo "  Image: $IMAGE_NAME:$VERSION"
echo "  Region: $REGION"
echo "  Project: $PROJECT_ID"
echo ""

gcloud run services replace cloud-run-config.yaml --region $REGION

# Wait for deployment to be ready
echo -e "${YELLOW}⏳ Waiting for deployment to be ready...${NC}"
sleep 30

# Get the service URL
SERVICE_URL=$(gcloud run services describe $SERVICE_NAME --region $REGION --format='value(status.url)')

# Test the deployment
echo -e "${YELLOW}🧪 Testing deployment...${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}Testing simple health endpoint: $SERVICE_URL/health/simple${NC}"

# Wait a bit more for the application to fully start
sleep 15

# Test with retries using the simple health endpoint
for i in {1..5}; do
    echo -e "${YELLOW}Attempt $i/5: Testing simple health endpoint...${NC}"
    if curl -f -s "$SERVICE_URL/health/simple" > /dev/null; then
        echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Simple health check passed!${NC}"
        break
    else
        echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠️  Simple health check failed, retrying in 10 seconds...${NC}"
        sleep 10
    fi
done

# Also test the full health endpoint
echo -e "${BLUE}Testing full health endpoint: $SERVICE_URL/health${NC}"
if curl -f -s "$SERVICE_URL/health" > /dev/null; then
    echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Full health check passed!${NC}"
else
    echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠️  Full health check failed, but simple health check passed${NC}"
fi

# Final status
echo -e "${GREEN}🎉 Deployment completed successfully!${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}Service URL: $SERVICE_URL${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}Simple Health Check: $SERVICE_URL/health/simple${NC}"
